description.value: Tatak Pinoy Filipino Store is a Filipino specialty grocer on Joyce Street serving Vancouver's local community. It stocks authentic Filipino groceries, foods, and ingredients not typically found in mainstream supermarkets. A touring cyclist can access a neighborhood grocery option for culturally-specific supplies and refreshments.
